title: Maha Strategies Enterprise MCP Gateway - canonical v1 contract
transport: JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP messages over HTTPS POST

authorization.tenantBinding: The verified API key tenant and registered upstream tenant must match. A caller cannot select a tenant header.

registration.credentialStorage: Bearer and HMAC secrets are encrypted with AES-256-GCM and are never returned.
registration.discovery: A bounded tools/list request persists credential-safe tool names, descriptions, and input schemas.

serverPolicy.rule: Every method is explicit. tools/call requires one or more allowedToolNames from the latest validated discovery inventory.

slaControls.scope: Tenant-wide rate controls and per-server circuit state

enforcement.audit: Successful forwarding records method, server, latency, request hash, and ledger outcome without retaining tool arguments or response bodies.

legacyCompatibility.status: Compatibility only; not the canonical customer contract.
